Package common.utility

package common.utility
Tools for seeing what the robot is doing and checking it works.
  • Log: consistent console messages, sorted by how serious they are.
  • shuffleboard: Shuffleboard widgets in one line each, for showing values and tuning.
  • dashboard: values, autos and buttons on the dashboard, in one line each. They go to both Elastic and NarwhalDashboard.
  • narwhaldashboard: the server for the team's own web dashboard, being replaced by Elastic. Use dashboard rather than calling it directly.
  • tester: system checks to run in the pits before a match.
  • sysid: tests that measure a mechanism so SysId can work out its feedforward gains.

For logging values to review after a match, mechanisms and state machines already publish everything to NetworkTables, which the robot records to a log file for AdvantageScope.
